missing_input_exit: missing input file: nonzero exit naming it
night_order_by_id: nights run in audit.toml date order
code_priority_swapped: first applicable code in the stated order
rejected_resets_families: a rejected night leaves every bay's family as it was
qualification_ignored: a job runs only on a bay qualified for its family
touching_forbidden: windows are half-open; touching jobs share no minute
fee_not_charged: a changeover charges the fee of the ordered family pair
bay_busy_in_window: the bay's earlier job ends at or before the crew window starts
window_before_zero: no crew window starts before minute 0
bay_charge_inclusive: bay charge = minute rate x (end - start)
job_net_without_fee: job net = value - bay charge - its changeover fee
plan_lines_by_job_id: plan items ordered by start then job id
crew_flag_dropped: flag crew_load_high when crew minutes exceed the limit
margin_flag_dropped: flag low_margin when net is below the floor
families_after_dropped: families_after holds each bay's family at night end
region_not_by_site: a job's region is its client's site's region
segment_not_by_client: a job's segment is its client's segment
rollup_skips_empty_nights: rollups list every accepted night, including nights with no job
rollup_totals_partial: rollup totals of jobs_run, gross and net
rejected_night_omitted: rejected nights listed with empty plan and zero figures
output_paths_lowercase: instruction.md output paths region_North.json and others
